channel.title: Violations Watch: Bangladesh
channel.description: New incidents reported in Bangladesh. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Police fire tear gas and sound grenades to disperse garment workers protesting a new minimum wage in Gazipur on 25–26 Nov; a case is filed against 604 people over vandalism at a Savar factory
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Gazipur, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh. Types: Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Bangladesh police. Disputed or caveats: Some protesters clashed with police, confined a police inspector and torched a motorcycle. 5 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2388

item.title: Police fire tear gas as garment workers protesting the new minimum wage block highways in Gazipur, Bangladesh; police say 12 law enforcement personnel were injured in clashes
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Gazipur, Bangladesh. Types: Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Bangladesh police. Disputed or caveats: Police say protesters attacked law enforcement; injuries among workers not reported. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2276

item.title: Police disperse protesting garment workers with tear gas and sound grenades in Konabari, Gazipur, on 24 Nov amid wage unrest; highway blocked and a police box torched
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Gazipur, Bangladesh. Types: Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Bangladesh police. 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2023

item.title: Police detain Chattogram North district Awami League general secretary Ataur Rahman (The Daily Star)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Chattogram, Bangladesh. Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Bangladesh police. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1936

item.title: Police fire tear gas at garment workers protesting for higher minimum wages in Ashulia, Savar; about 50 factories close
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Ashulia, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh. Types: Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Bangladesh police. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1698

item.title: A crowd beats a man accused of posting blasphemous content on Facebook as police take him from his home in Feni; he and his wife are then held at the police station (Prothom Alo)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Feni, Chattogram Division, Bangladesh. Types: Persecution & repression, Torture & ill-treatment, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Local crowd (beating); police (detention). Reported casualties: 1-3 injured. Disputed or caveats: Accounts differ on which police officers were injured. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1291

item.title: A lawyer is beaten by BNP and Chhatra Dal activists at a Dhaka court during a remand hearing, then sent to jail the next day in an anti-terrorism case he says was fabricated (Prothom Alo)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Dhaka, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh. Types: Torture & ill-treatment, Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: BNP and Chhatra Dal activists (beating); police and court (detention). Reported casualties: 1 injured. Disputed or caveats: Police and prosecution say he admitted involvement in a 9 Nov crude-bomb blast; he denies it. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1292

item.title: Police fire tear gas and sound grenades at garment workers protesting for a higher minimum wage in Ashulia and Gazipur; workers and union leaders arrested (8 on 19 Nov; police in Gazipur say 80 arrested; IndustriALL says 12 union leaders held) and a journalist seriously injured (Daily Star, Prothom Alo, Amnesty)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Ashulia, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh. Types: Persecution & repression, Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Attacks on journalists. Alleged perpetrator: Bangladesh police. Reported casualties: 1+ injured. Disputed or caveats: Rumor Scanner found claims that police shot a worker dead to be false. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1290

item.title: Detective Branch police detain actress Jyotika Jyoti and actor Tomal Mahbub in Dhaka on 19 Nov, and police arrest a former AL lawmaker and other members of the banned Awami League, citing sabotage allegations without stating charges (Prothom Alo, The Daily Star)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Dhaka, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh. Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Bangladesh police (Detective Branch, SRB). Disputed or caveats: Police cite sabotage allegations; detainees say no warrant was shown; no case details given. 6 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1374
